name: Lincoln, NE
extract_hints: Lincoln conventions: lettered streets run east-west (A St through Y St, with O St the main one); numbered streets run north-south, and "27th" means N 27th or S 27th depending on side of O St. If the side isn't stated, omit the prefix. Common names: Cornhusker Hwy, Capitol Pkwy, Nebraska Pkwy, Old Cheney Rd, Pioneers Blvd, Van Dorn St, Holdrege St, Superior St, Highway 2, I-80. Police units are phonetic letter + number (Baker 12, Charlie 4); fire units are Engine/Truck/Medic/Battalion + number; sheriff units are "Lancaster" + number. LPD = Lincoln Police, LFR = Lincoln Fire & Rescue, LSO = Lancaster County Sheriff.
